integrity: A complete analytic proof and reproducibility checker are provided. Literature comparison is bounded and independent audit is not performed.
scientific_limitations: Three-site real upper-bidiagonal matrices with positive off-diagonal weights; Euclidean GMRES(2) and matching identity-preconditioned first two-grid cycle only; exact arithmetic. No general larger-dimensional, floating-point or nonlinear claim. Scalar minimum need not have radical closed form.
title: Sharp anisotropic two-step GMRES stagnation frontier for a three-site bidiagonal system
